description: The chart illustrates classification accuracy results (in percent) for an “Ours” method and several ablation variants across two datasets, shown as two side-by-side panels labeled “PHEME” (left) and “PolitiFact” (right). The category axis is horizontal in each panel, with six labeled conditions in the same left-to-right order: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” with labels angled; there is no explicit x-axis title. The value axis is the vertical y-axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 75 to 95, with evenly spaced tick marks at 2.5-point intervals (e.g., 75.0, 77.5, …, 95.0). In the PHEME panel, the bars are colored dark red for “Ours” at 89.84, orange for “w/o comments” at 86.82, pale yellow for “w/o text” at 80.10, very light blue for “w/o select” at 88.80, medium blue for “w/o emotion” at 87.34, and dark blue for “w/o cognition” at 87.17, with each value printed above its bar. In the PolitiFact panel, the same color scheme and category order are used, with “Ours” (dark red) at 90.57, “w/o comments” (orange) at 85.85, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 83.02, “w/o select” (very light blue) at 89.62, “w/o emotion” (medium blue) at 84.91, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.74, again with numeric annotations above each bar. The bars are presented as single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars per category within each dataset panel, and there is no legend; the categories are not shown as explicitly sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors and the value labels.
